meta.title: A rejection through the status endpoint never blocks re-bidding
gaps: The buyer's rejection through the status endpoint cannot be expressed because its METHOD, path, and body are not provided and no operation covers it.
The plan cannot verify that a status rejection never blocks re-bidding while the RFQ remains open.
the case reads as “it is accepted”, but the plan checks “it is refused”

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event where the invited QA vendor bid, and the bidding window is over.
steps: The invited QA vendor places a complete bid (open, price, submit).
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that the round counts no new bid (the refused bid left nothing).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Order not active”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: the round counts no new bid (the refused bid left nothing).

plan.title: A rejection through the status endpoint never blocks re-bidding

assert.say: the round counts no new bid (the refused bid left nothing)
